name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the context of the conversation and the interesting fact provided. It assesses whether the continuation is on topic and logically follows the preceding dialogue.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses how logically and smoothly the response integrates with the previous conversation. It checks for consistency in the storyline and the logical flow of ideas.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is incoherent and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to sustain or increase the interest of the conversation. It considers how likely the continuation would prompt further interaction or curiosity from the conversational partner.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging at all and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response. It looks at whether the response adds a unique or unexpected twist that enhances the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative at all and 5 is highly creative.

name: Linguistic Quality
description: Checks the grammatical correctness, vocabulary richness, and overall linguistic expression of the response. It assesses how well the response is articulated in terms of language use.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is poor linguistic quality and 5 is excellent linguistic quality.
